items.title: Skills are just programs for LLMs
items.summary: A skill is the program an LLM runs, so whole apps can be built as skills. That's the take from Michael, who created the first version of Claude Code artifacts at Anthropic. My idea from there is orchestration as skills. Set up a message board for agents in different ways, run the experiments side by side and see which performs best, with skills coming from the wider community, not only from us. Spacesheep is provider-agnostic artifacts for any AI agent. items.title: Why the Same Food Spikes Some People
items.summary: In episode 1043 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Dr. Guru Banavar, Founding CTO at Viome, why the same food can cause different blood sugar responses in different people. Dr. Banavar explains a study involving 1,100 participants that tracked continuous glucose responses to specific foods. This research allowed them to predict with 80% accuracy which foods would spike an individual's blood sugar, highlighting the personalized nature of dietary impact.

items.summary: Most people never knew ChatGPT plugins existed, because you had to find them and switch them on by hand. With agents, the agent should find the right skill and bring it to you. While planning skills for Spacesheep, I went through the skill and plugin stores of the last few years to see what worked and what didn't. The ones that work make a skill easy to find and install. items.title: The 45,000 GPU Myth: Are Indian AI Startups Stuck in a Subsidy Trap?

items.title: The AI That Runs Without Internet: Inside India's Offline 'Dhīr' Model
items.summary: Switch your phone to aeroplane mode. Now ask it a question in Odia. Most of the AI you have heard about will wait politely for a signal that is never coming. Enter Dhīr: a small, open-source language model from ZenteiQ that runs entirely offline. Built to support English and ten Indian languages, it aims to put sovereign AI directly onto local servers and mobile devices. But India has announced "sovereign AI" before, and many of those announcements are still waiting for their first actual customer. Is Dhīr the real deal, or just another theoretical launch in the ₹10,371 crore IndiaAI Mission? In this episode of Front Page, we sit down with Professor Sashikumaar Ganesan of the Indian Institute of Science and founder of ZenteiQ, to test the claims behind India's newest AI model. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 📌 Note: The video thumbnail is for representational purposes and was created with the assistance of AI. 📩 For inquiries or questions, contact us at: info@aimmediahouse.com ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 📌 ABOUT FRONT PAGE Front Page is a daily live news briefing covering AI, enterprise tech, semiconductors, and India’s role in the global technology economy.
